question: In Gastric/GEJ combination therapy trials, normalize the combination type to standardized labels (e.g., ICI+Chemo, ICI+TKI, ICI+ICI).

steps.desc: Filter Gastric/GEJ combination therapy trials and select relevant columns.
steps.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT "NCT", "PubMed ID" AS "PMID", "Trial name", "Cancer type", "Treatment regimen", "Type of combination", "Monotherapy/combination"
  FROM compat.clinical_trials
  WHERE LOWER("Cancer type") LIKE '%gastric%' OR LOWER("Cancer type") LIKE '%gej%'
  AND LOWER("Monotherapy/combination") LIKE '%combination%'
)
SELECT * FROM base;

steps.desc: Map free text to controlled combination type categories.
steps.prompt: For each row, read Type of combination, Treatment regimen, and Trial name and emit JSON {NCT, PMID, combination_type} with label in ["ICI+Chemo", "ICI+TKI", "ICI+ICI", "ICI+Other", "Chemo+TKI", "Chemo+Other", "Other", "unknown"]. Heuristics: If ICI and Chemo are present, then ICI+Chemo; If ICI and TKI are present, then ICI+TKI; If multiple ICIs are present, then ICI+ICI; If ICI and something else, then ICI+Other; If Chemo and TKI are present, then Chemo+TKI; If Chemo and something else, then Chemo+Other; If none of the above, then Other. Default to unknown. Output JSON objects only—one per input row; no prose.

steps.desc: Validate label set and drop invalid rows.
